hyperedges.label: Yazi Plugin Install & Configure Pattern (ya pkg add + keymap.toml/init.lua)
Shared Lucide-derived SVG icon set used across quickshell shell UI components (notifications, brightness, navigation)
Brand/logo image assets identifying the two ecosystems this config is built from (Hyprland, ML4W)
Power-menu action icons (lock, logout, power, reboot) shared across quickshell power/session UI
Quick-action/utility icons (theme toggle, color picker, screenshot, package/update) likely used in sidebar or quick-action UI
Quickshell shared power/quick-action icons all sourced from the lucide icon library (settings, suspend/monitor-pause, terminal, theme/swatch-book, volume, volume-muted, wallpaper)
ML4W logo icon variant set: same brand mark across raster/vector formats, sizes (20px vs full), and color themes (teal main, black, white, dark)
wlogout power menu action icon set (hibernate, lock, logout, reboot, shutdown, suspend)
